About MammoLingo

MammoLingo explains common mammogram terms in plain language and suggests questions to discuss with a clinician.

Move around the app

Use Home, Browse, Saved, and About to move between screens. On a phone, these options appear in the bottom navigation bar. The number beside Saved shows how many terms are saved. You can also use Back to home at the bottom of each screen.

Find a term

On Home, enter a term, abbreviation, or BI-RADS number and select Search, or choose one of the topic shortcuts. Browse shows the available terms and topic shortcuts. Use Clear search to return to the full list. If you don’t find a match, try a shorter or related term.

Read an explanation

Select a term’s card to open its explanation, suggested clinician questions, and source. Use the close button to return to the list. External source links open the publisher’s website.

Save terms for later

Select the star beside a term to save it, then open Saved to see your list. Select the star again to remove one term, or use Clear all to remove the list. Saved terms stay in this browser on this device; they don’t sync to other devices and may be lost if browser data is cleared.

Read offline

After the app has loaded successfully online, its glossary and saved terms are intended to be available offline in supported browsers. An offline message appears when there is no connection. Links to external sources need an internet connection. If an app update is available, use Reload app to load it.

Privacy and limits

No account or report upload is needed. Search stays on this device; please don’t enter report text or personal details. If browser storage is unavailable, you can still search and read, but bookmarks may not be saved.

MammoLingo provides general education. It cannot interpret your report, diagnose a condition, replace clinical advice, or recommend a test or follow-up plan. Discuss your results and circumstances with a clinician.

The footer shows the content library version and its educational scope. Select Sources and standards to learn more, then use its close button to return to the page. For feedback about the app, use the public GitHub issue tracker; do not include a report, symptoms, or other personal or health information.

Sources and standards

Each entry is independently written for general education and links to a public source. This selected library covers common U.S. mammography-report vocabulary; it is not a complete report dictionary or an official BI-RADS® lexicon. Terminology appearing in reports may be named to help readers recognize it. Source names and trademarks belong to their respective owners; their inclusion does not imply affiliation or endorsement. BI-RADS® is a registered trademark of the American College of Radiology. MammoLingo is educational content, not medical advice: it cannot interpret a report, diagnose a condition, or recommend care. Discuss your results and circumstances with a clinician. External sources need an internet connection.
